plan.title: Recreate Order available on live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ without creating or searching for another event.
Assert Recreate Order is present and clickable in the current RFQ Settings menu.
Click Recreate Order and leave its confirmation window open.
Assert that selecting Recreate Order opens a dialog/window.
Cancel the Recreate Order window so no order is changed.
Assert the dialog closed after cancellation.
